entry.name: rnbo_groove~
entry.digest: Variable-rate looping sample playback of a sized buffer
entry.description: The groove~ object is a variable-rate, looping, sample-playback object which references the audio information stored in a buffer~ object having the same name.

arguments.name: buffername
arguments.description: Names theobject containing the sample to be used byfor playback.

arguments.name: channels
arguments.description: A second argument may specify the number of output channels. The default number of channels is 1. If thebeing played has fewer channels than the number ofoutput channels, the extra channels output a zero signal. If thehas more channels and is a multiple of 2 or 4, channels are mixed.
